source_scope: §6.1 Gaussian variance calculation immediately before Eq. (51) and Eq. (51) itself, fixed x under the actual unconditioned coefficient law. No integration over x.
signature:
theorem weightedRadialLevels_gaussian_mgf (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ)
    (β : Fin (h + 1) → ℝ)
    (x : Fin (h + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val)) :
    let L := Fin (h + 1)
    let P := {p : Fin (2 ^ (64 * (h + 1)) + 1) // Even p.val ∧ 4 ≤ p.val}
    let B := L × P
    let C := fun b : B ↦
      ((Fin b.2.val.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - b.1.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)
    let E := fun b : B ↦ EuclideanSpace ℝ (C b)
    let degree := fun p : P ↦
      (⟨p.val.val, p.property.1, p.property.2, Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.val.isLt⟩ :
        {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    let S := fun i : L ↦ ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
    let a := fun (i : L) (p : P) ↦ 1 / ((p.val.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S i : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S i)))
    let χ := fun r : ℝ ↦
      expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) /
        (expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) + expNegInvGlue (7 / 10 - r)) *
      (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) /
        (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) + expNegInvGlue (r - 19 / 20)))
    let tail := fun (i : L) (j : Fin (h - i.val + 1)) ↦ x ⟨i.val + j.val, by omega⟩
    let c := fun i : L ↦ ∏ j, χ (‖tail i j‖ / Real.sqrt n.val)
    let field := fun (i : L) (z : (p : P) → E (i, p)) ↦
      if ∃ j, tail i j = 0 then 0 else
        c i * ∑ p : P, angularDegreeComponent n h i (degree p)
          (fun j ↦ NormedSpace.normalize (tail i j)) (z p)
    let Ω := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)
    let H := fun (ξ : Ω) (i : L) ↦ field i
      (fun p ↦ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun k : C (i, p) ↦ ξ ⟨(i, p), k⟩))
    let μ := stdGaussian Ω
    let W := fun ξ : Ω ↦ ∑ i : L, β i * H ξ i
    let V := (n.val : ℝ) * ∑ i : L, β i ^ 2 * (c i) ^ 2 * ∑ p : P, (a i p) ^ 2
    HasLaw W (gaussianReal 0 V.toNNReal) μ ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ ↦ Real.exp (-W ξ)) μ ∧
      (∫ ξ, Real.exp (-W ξ) ∂μ) = Real.exp (V / 2)

TYPING: n positive, h natural, full deterministic x=(x_0,…,x_h). Same exact degree set, tensor carrier, cutoffs and zero extension as the checked joint-level law.
β gives one deterministic real weight per level. The same field and coefficient draw are used for every term.
STANDING: The source fixes the positive recursive weights from Eq. (18) and large n with the prescribed depth. The fixed-point Gaussian calculation holds for arbitrary real weights and positive n / natural h; this generalizes only the identity, not the recursion, admissibility or bounds.
derived_not_assumed: Actual independence and marginal laws, finite moments, weighted sum HasLaw, nonnegativity of its variance and integrability of exp(-W), including variance zero.

definition_audit.body: No new global definitions. All local coefficient and field lets match the checked actual joint level law. W is the source weighted sum on those fields. V is n times the finite sum of β_i² C_i(x)² v_i, with v_i the exact sum of squared amplitudes. V/2 is exactly the displayed exponent n/2 times the sum. The measure is the original joint stdGaussian, not spatial γ_n or a restricted measure.

source_regions.meaning: Exact fixed-x radial fields on the original coefficient sample.
At fixed x all degree fields are independent centered Gaussians; the exact variance includes the radial factor.
The finite weighted sum is centered Gaussian, variance n times the weighted squared-amplitude sum.
Evaluate the real Gaussian MGF at t=-1 to obtain exp(V/2).
Prove the exponential integrable rather than relying on the totalized real integral. Degenerate factor laws are permitted.

source_regions.reason: No beta recursion, cutoff support estimate, identity to the actual nonlinear weight outside its good event, spatial integral M, conditional or tilted law, mass bounds, or main lower bounds.

source_edges.use_site: Fixed-x finite Gaussian variance calculation preceding Eq. (51).
Eq. (51) uses the actual one-dimensional law at t=-1.
The finite positive Gaussian MGF gives the needed real exponential integrability; no extra assumption.

alternative_implementation: Lean reuses the already verified actual level product law instead of resumming the individual degree fields. Obtain exact marginals and mutual independence, scale and sum the Gaussians, then use mgf_gaussianReal and mgf_pos_iff. Source and Lean graph layers stay separate.
reuse_search: Samplinglib: verified RadialLevels.radialLevels_hasLaw, AngularDegreeSum finite Gaussian assembly, cells and issue388. No duplicate actual Eq. (51) theorem.
Mathlib: gaussianReal_const_mul, iIndepFun.hasGaussianLaw_fun_sum, IndepFun.variance_sum, mgf_gaussianReal, mgf_pos_iff. No generic weighted-Gaussian wrapper.
truth_boundary: The actual unconditioned weighted scalar law and Eq. (51) integrability/expectation at one deterministic x. No pointwise domination across x, M integral, gates, conditioning, tilted Gaussian, mass bound or query lower bound.
consumer: §6.1 scale m(x) and M, then the total and good mass comparison in Lemma 6.2. The weighted MGF is not the nonlinear load bound or prefix conditioning.
